text:
Asha (engineering lead): quick follow-up from today's all-hands on the routing degradation incident. RCA here: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-03-22-routing-degrade (internal). posting actions and owners in this thread.

Ben (SRE): read the RCA. we need a short preflight check for route weight changes. idea: validate per-path latency and fallback behavior before pushing weights to 100%.

Gina (ops): i'll add a preflight job to the deploy pipeline. ETA: tomorrow morning.

Jon (product): request from PMs: can we include a customer-friendly summary in the Console timeline? one sentence + link to status.

Hector (support): will need the affected orgs list and the exact impact window. can someone paste that here?

Asha (engineering lead): impact window in RCA: 02:1202:55 UTC, increased tail latency leading to automatic fallback for ~9% of routed requests. affected: customers using dedicated routing + route-splitting.

Ben (SRE): added a temporary circuit-breaker rule to avoid cascading fallbacks. owner: Ben. i'll remove after we verify KV fix.

Gina (ops): exporting org list now, will drop in secure drive and DM support.

Jon (product): i'll write the Console blurb once support confirms list. Hector, want to co-author?

Hector (support): yes, i'll pair with you. also prepping canned responses for emails.

inc-bot: automation: checklist created in RCA doc with tasks assigned to owners.

Ben (SRE): note about telemetry: some traces didn't include route_id tag. added a small PR to instrumentation. link: https://redwood.internal/git/trace-fix.

Asha (engineering lead): good catch. add that to the regression test matrix. Dina (eng-ml) volunteered earlier to help with tests in a follow thread.

Jon (product): small roadmap ask: add "route-level observability" P2 to Optimize backlog. flagged.

Gina (ops): dashboard updates: will add a per-route p95/p99 and a fallback-count panel. ETA 48h.

Ben (SRE): planning a 45m blameless review next Tue to walk timeline and decisions. i'll send invite.

Asha (engineering lead): please include logs + timeline excerpt in the invite so attendees can prep.

Hector (support): once the Console blurb is ready i'll post to #support and prepare the outbound note for impacted customers.

Jon (product): customers prefer simple language. proposed sentence: "We experienced increased latency affecting a subset of routing configurations; engineers have deployed a fix and we've taken steps to prevent regression."

Asha (engineering lead): that reads fine. Jon/Hector, iterate and post when ready.

Ben (SRE): opened the preflight smoke script here: https://redwood.internal/tools/route-preflight.sh. please test and give feedback.

Gina (ops): confirmed file pulled into deploy pipeline. will run on next canary.

Asha (engineering lead): final checklist in RCA: Ben (preflight + circuit-breaker), Gina (dashboards + pipeline job), Jon (customer blurb), Hector (support comms). please mark status in the doc when done.

Ben (SRE): marking preflight as in-progress.

Gina (ops): dashboards in-progress.

Jon (product): drafting blurb now.

Hector (support): prepping outreach templates.

Asha (engineering lead): thanks all. i'll summarize status at next all-hands and link back to the RCA as single source of truth. any blockers shout here or DM me.

Jon (product): small follow-up: can we add a one-click link from RCA to the deploy that triggered the change? would help audits.

Ben (SRE): yes we can. will add deploy metadata to RCA header.

inc-bot: deploy to canary pool gpux-dedicated-2 (canary=5%) started by Ben 026-03-22-rca-followup-build.

Ben (SRE): canary metrics look healthy at 5%. next bump after smoke job passes.

Asha (engineering lead): cheers, appreciate the quick turnaround.
